name: Twig DateTime
description: adds a Twig function to create a datetime from a given date.
project_description:
A simple Drupal module to create a DateTime from given date using Twig.

 Features 
 Useful for outputting dates in a DateTime format for calendars. 

 Post-Installation 
 In Twig, simply use the get_datetime() function with a date within the function.

 Supporting this Module 
 This was created for internal use to extend upon an iCal export feature we had but we chose to make it available to the Drupal community. If anyone wants to become a co-maintainer and improve upon it, please let us know.
